$comment: Pinned so a release build is reproducible: the compiler is part of the input, and two
SDK patch levels produce different assemblies (measured: 395264 vs 395776 bytes for the
same commit). CI installs exactly this version from here - the workflow deliberately
passes no dotnet-version of its own, so there is one place that decides.
Raising it is a normal change; it just has to be a deliberate one.
